crossRefs.note: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
‘They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of…
The king spoke to Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of…
The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to…
At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in…

translations.web: He will take one tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers, and to his servants.
translations.bsb: He will take a tenth of your grain and grape harvest and give it to his officials and servants.
translations.kjv: And he will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.
